fee_notes: Royalty: 6% of monthly Gross Revenue, due monthly via ACH on the 10th. Local Marketing minimum: $350/month; affiliate charges $7.50 per completed appointment for new clients. Email & Text Remarketing: $3.50 per completed appointment plus $60/location/month (max 20% annual increase). Reception and Customer Experience Fee: $3.25 per serviced appointment/month (capped at 10% of current non-member Brazilian female wax price). Software Fees: (1) Messaging Software $108.05/license/month; (2) Email & Storage Software $8.40/license/month; (3) TV Management Software $4.50/TV/month; (4) Social Platform Marketing $60/location/month; (5) Review Software $30/location/month; (6) SEO & GEO Software $50/location/month. Brand Fund: currently $0, reserved right to charge up to 2% of monthly Gross Revenue. Advertising Cooperative: currently not assessed, maximum 2% of Gross Revenue. Technology Fee: currently $75/month, capped at $150/month; plus one-time Business Management System fee of $7,500 per owner. Training Fee: $5,250 (Suite) or $10,500 (Flagship). Recertification Fee: $55/graded video (typically $110 total). Trainer Development Fee: $500/esthetician. MCR Coaching Program: $300/esthetician (optional). Interim Management Support Fee: 20% of Gross Revenue (current), up to 25% max. Renewal Fee: $2,500. Transfer Fee: $1,000 (existing owner) or $5,000 (new owner) plus broker/third-party fees.

Royalty Fee | 6% of monthly Gross Revenue. | Monthly via ACH on the 10th day for the immediately preceding month. | Payable to us. See footnote 1.
Required Minimum Expenditure for Local Marketing and Advertising | Not less than $350 per month. If you use our affiliate to provide these services, our affiliate currently charges a flat fee of $7.50 per completed appointment for each new client. | As incurred. | All advertising must be pre-approved. See footnote 2.
Email and Text Remarketing | The then-current amount, which is currently, $3.50 per completed appointment, plus $60 per location per month. This fee will not increase by more than 20% each year. | As incurred. | Payable to our affiliate.
Reception and Customer Experience Fee | Flat fee of $3.25 per serviced appointment in a month. The Reception and Customer Experience Fee will not exceed 10% of the price of the current non-member Brazilian female wax. | Monthly via ACH on the 10th day for the immediately preceding month. | Payable to us.
Recertification Fee | The then-current fee, which is currently $55 per graded recertification video. Typically, two videos are submitted for a total of $110. | As incurred | Payable to us or our affiliate.
Software Fees | 1. Messaging Software ($108.05/license/month); 2. Email & Storage Software ($8.40/license/month); 3. Television Management Software ($4.50/TV/month); 4. Social Platform Marketing Fee ($60/location/month); 5. Review Software ($30/location/month); 6. SEO & GEO Software ($50/location/month). | Monthly via ACH on the 10th day of the month. | Payable to us or our affiliate.
Brand Fund | We do not currently charge a Brand Fund contribution, but we reserve the right to charge a Brand Fund contribution up to two percent (2%) of monthly Gross Revenue. | Monthly via ACH on the 10th day of the month. | We reserve the right to increase the Brand Fund Contribution up to two percent (2%) of monthly Gross Revenue.
Advertising Cooperative | Currently not assessed. Maximum of 2% of Gross Revenue. | As determined by cooperative. | No cooperatives have been established as of the date of this Disclosure Document.
Technology Fee | Currently $75 per month, subject to increase. The Technology Fee will not cost more than $150 per month. | Monthly via ACH on the 10th day of each month. | Payable to us. Also required: one-time Business Management System fee of $7,500 per owner.
Training Fee | $5,250 for a Suite, and $10,500 for a Flagship. | Prior to attending training | Payable to us.
Additional Training | Currently, we do not charge a fee; however, maximum amount is $10,500 per year. | As incurred. |
Trainer Development Fee | $500 per esthetician. | As incurred. | Payable to us.
Membership Conversion Rate ("MCR") Coaching Program | $300 per esthetician. | Prior to attending training | Optional.
Interim Management Support Fee | Current rate is 20% of Gross Revenue; will not increase to more than 25% of Gross Revenue. | As incurred. |
Renewal Fee | $2,500 | Upon signing the then-current form franchise agreement. | Payable to us.
Transfer Fee | Transfer to an existing owner: $1,000 plus broker/third-party fees. Transfer to a new owner: $5,000 plus broker/third-party fees. | At the time of transfer. | Payable to us.
